description: This PHP source file defines the PimDefinedReportAPI class, which provides API endpoints for managing PIM (Product Information Management) reports within an HRM system. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting PIM report configurations, along with related validation rules and annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: PimDefinedReportAPI
classes.description: API class handling CRUD operations and management of PIM Defined Reports in the HR system. Implements endpoints for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting report configurations, with validation and Swagger API documentation annotations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all PIM reports with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new PIM report configuration.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to delete existing PIM reports based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific PIM report by its ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing PIM report configuration.
